title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression checks and gating
author: Anika Shah
description: Motivation: add a lightweight CI hook that runs eval-harness prompt-set regressions on pull requests touching model prompt sets or evaluation configs to prevent accidental quality regressions. This PR implements a new git hook + GitHub Action that executes a curated subset of prompt-based evaluations (fast smoke set) and fails the CI job when regressions exceed configured thresholds. Key goals: 1) provide early signal on prompt regressions to authors and reviewers, 2) keep CI cost low by running a minimal fast-suite by default and enabling full-suite on a staging queue, 3) make thresholds configurable per-team via eval config. What this change does: adds a new GitHub Action workflow .github/workflows/eval-prompt-regression.yml that triggers on pull_request and pull_request_target for paths matching eval-harness/**, prompt-sets/**, tests/evals/**; implements a fast-suite runner in eval-harness/ci/fast_suite.py that loads lightweight prompt subsets and computes A/B metrics (exact match, pass@k, custom scorer). Introduces a gating wrapper that compares metrics to baseline snapshots stored in eval-harness/ci/baselines/*.json and posts a comment with a short summary. Adds documentation and an opt-out label (ci/no-eval-gate) to bypass gating for urgent infra-only changes. Backwards compatibility: default workflow uses low-cost model variants and a 0.5% regression threshold to reduce noise; teams can opt into stricter gates via linear ticket ENG-4521. See checklist: [x] add workflow [x] implement fast-suite runner [x] add baseline loading and diffing [x] post PR comment with summary and links [x] unit tests for runner [x] docs update and README entry [x] add opt-out label. Related: ENG-4521 (team gating configuration), ENG-4600 (baseline snapshot refresh).

See docs/ci/eval-gating.md for details.
